name: IGEX
summary: IGEX was an enriched-76Ge double-beta-decay experiment whose Canfranc apparatus was also upgraded for WIMP nuclear-recoil searches. Only deployments with explicit dark-matter data are included on this map.
detection_principle: Low-background high-purity germanium measures the ionization spectrum of WIMP-induced nuclear recoils; optimized low-energy shielding and pulse processing control backgrounds.

status.evidence: Original 2001–2002 papers confirm dark-matter operation at Canfranc; the project's termination date requires verification.

key_parameters.name: Original purpose
key_parameters.value: Double-beta decay and low-background rare processes

results.summary: WIMP-scattering limits were obtained with germanium ionization detectors.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.

media.caption: Historical photograph of the IGEX-DM RG-2 germanium-detector cryostat inside lead shielding, explicitly associated with dark-matter data taking. From María Luisa Sarsa's 2008 review of dark-matter experiments at Canfranc, Figure 19(b), PDF page 78 (journal page 81).
